import type { Register } from 'claude-code'

import { sources } from './sources'
import { band } from './ui/band'
import { builtin } from './ui/builtin'
import { pane } from './ui/pane'
import { hoursOf } from './ui/views/timeline'

export const register: Register = (on, options) => {
  sources(on, String(options.pricesFile ?? ''))
  band(on)
  pane(on, hoursOf(options.timelineHours))
  if (options.hideBuiltinTasks !== false) builtin(on)
}

import type { On } from 'claude-code'

import { agents } from './agents'
import { codex } from './codex'
import { crons } from './crons'
import { monitors } from './monitors'
import { shells } from './shells'
import { workflows } from './workflows'
import { worktrees } from './worktrees'

export type Source = (on: On) => void

// `file`: the user's price table (option `pricesFile`), '' for none.
export function sources(on: On, file: string): void {
  agents(on, file)
  workflows(on)
  codex(on, file)
  shells(on)
  monitors(on)
  crons(on)
  worktrees(on)
}
